provenance.construction: Dense-packed rotated surface code, brick-staggered in two dimensions: 4 bands at vertical pitch 12 (the measured threshold pitch_min(9); not any fixed offset from d), band r carrying 3 patches for even r and 2 for odd r at horizontal patch pitch 2d+2 = 20, odd bands offset 10 to the right; 10 distance-9 patches fused into one contiguous connected weight-4 patch giving k = rows*m - floor(rows/2) = 10. The two-band, pitch d-1 case is the five-logical packing of arXiv:2511.06758 (Fujiu, Nagayama, Nishio, Kawaguchi, Satoh); the raised-pitch band stagger and second-dimension extension are not in that paper. Data qubits at odd/odd sites, (x+y) mod 4 == 2 ancillas measure X-checks and the remaining occupied sites measure Z-checks, every check acting on its four diagonal data neighbours; even bands carry (x+y) mod 4 == 0 checks on vertical patch edges and == 2 on horizontal edges, odd bands the reverse. Single layer, tilted nearest-neighbour lattice, interaction radius sqrt(2).
provenance.notes: Same construction as the board's [[418,10,7]] and the open [[615,15,7]], lifted to d=9 at the measured threshold pitch 12 (not d+1; an earlier staged draft asserted that false relation and was corrected before submission). k = 4*3-2 = 10. Not equivalent to any board entry. Mutually non-dominated with those, the d=9 ladder rungs [[447,7,9]], [[569,9,9]], and the d=5 multi-band entries. Distance is a witness-backed upper bound from 20000 RIS trials per side, not a certified exact distance.
